decision: D1. A Receipt that needs no VAT code (a top-up) counts as Has, so settlement top-ups stay in Ready to export
ran the receipts and readiness suites
Has VAT code means start export accepts the Receipt's code, not that a code is set; on e-conomic a purchase with no code counts as Has
why: instead of Has meaning a code is set; assumes users read "No VAT code" as "would block export"
